name: open-imagine
description: Create images and songs with your own Open Imagine studio.

interface.longDescription: Turns a brief into still images or a song on your own Open Imagine studio, a local image, video, voice and music studio for Apple Silicon. It plans the shot or the arrangement, writes the prompt or the sectioned lyrics, generates, inspects the result and refines it with edits.
defaultPrompt: make a phone wallpaper of my cat
shoot a product photo set for this mug
make a warm piano pop song about leaving home
